keep_features.evidence_span: "if something like the green New deal actually passed, it would get hundreds of hours"
keep_features.rationale: Uses an explicit if-conditional to describe downstream effects.

keep_features.evidence_span: "Trump... kisses Iran’s ass and tells Netanyahu to back off and stop fighting"
